titleEn: How AgXeed and TIM make tractors and machines autonomous
titleZh: AgXeed与TIM推出改造套件，让现有拖拉机实现自动驾驶
summaryZh: 荷兰制造商AgXeed推出VCU（车辆控制单元）和TCU（工具控制单元）改造套件，可将现有拖拉机及农机具升级为自动驾驶设备。该方案基于其田间机器人技术，面向不愿或无法投资专用田间机器人、但希望将自主作业能力集成到现有农机车队中的承包商、种植户和畜牧养殖户。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了农机自动化从专用机器人向存量设备改造的延伸，为畜牧养殖户在自有拖拉机上实现自主作业提供了低成本路径，对智慧畜牧中的饲喂、清粪等环节的自动化升级具有参考价值。
contentFull:
How AgXeed and TIM make tractors and machines autonomous

 06-08 | Autonomous vehicles | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The Dutch manufacturer AgXeed now also offers retrofit kits to make existing tractors and machines autonomous. Photos: René Koerhuis

 AgXeed can now make existing tractors and machines autonomous with VCU and TCU retrofit kits. This is based on the approach and philosophy familiar from field robots. Contractors, growers and livestock farmers who do not want to or cannot invest in a field robot, or who also want to integrate autonomy into their existing machinery fleet, can now turn to AgXeed. To this end, the manufacturer from Grubbenvorst, Limburg, is introducing the VCU (Vehicle Control Unit) and TCU (Tool Control Unit)
